page.notes: The woodcut initial E is an engraved picture of a figure and is joined to the first word "ERIT". Printed "ut uocãt" and other abbreviations kept as printed. The page number at the head is a small mark read as 3 with doubt. The last word "alijs" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. The printed line "alij" ends the paragraph at the foot of the column.
